content: Regions with advanced road networks and fewer bottlenecks allow for higher fleet turnover rates, effectively increasing the operational capacity of the fleet without necessitating the acquisition of additional vehicles. Conversely, investments in infrastructure to manage existing bottlenecks are crucial for unlocking latent fleet capacity in historically underserved or congested regions [15] . This dynamic ensures that infrastructure progress remains a critical issue for South Africa’s logistics landscape, directly impacting how and where companies deploy their bulk transport assets to maximize regional coverage [1][1] . This substantial financial injection was specifically targeted at unlocking new mining areas and upgrading critical infrastructure at the South Deep mine, thereby illustrating a clear intent to expand operational capacity within South Africa [33] . As these expanded mining areas become fully operational, the resultant increase in extracted ore will directly translate into heightened demand for bulk transport services. In addition to domestic projects, broader continental developments also influence the regional logistics ecosystem. Market intelligence highlights numerous anticipated African mining milestones expected to be achieved in 2026, spanning a diverse array of critical commodities including copper, gold, and lithium [6] . While the specific geographical distribution of these projects varies, the interconnected nature of Southern African supply chains means that regional expansions often utilize South African port infrastructure and transit corridors, thereby compounding the demand on local logistics networks [6] . Consequently, logistics operators must maintain a comprehensive view of both domestic and cross-border mining developments to accurately forecast capacity requirements. This surge in physical output was accompanied by a significant expansion in financial yields, with mineral sales growing by an impressive R89 billion during the same period. However, industry analysts and economic reports indicate that this pronounced uptick must be contextualized within the broader historical performance of the sector. Specifically, the sharp recovery has been attributed, in large part, to a notably low base of comparison from 2025, a year that was characterized by relatively weak performance across multiple commodity segments [44][45] .
